HERO_META_ROLES.uses: Hero header metadata painter: colours meta row n with HERO_META_ROLES[n % 3] (hero_header.rs). The three colours hero headers already used, defined once so destinations cannot style metadata.

HINT_PILL_FILLS.uses: Library Hero overlay display-only hint chips, rotated by chip index (widgets.rs hint pills). Chip surfaces, not text roles, so a text-colour edit cannot move them.

roles.name: SURFACE_BACKDROP
roles.uses: App backdrop: library column gutter, pill-row gap, playback status pill, artwork placeholder, queue panel resting box, main content-box resting half.

roles.name: SURFACE_CHROME
roles.uses: Non-focusable structural chrome: status bar, tab bar, sidebar bands, queue panel band, queue-only playback strip (both states).

roles.name: SURFACE_FOCUSED
roles.uses: Focused fill for ColumnPane/ContentBody/Recess levels: queue column, hero pane, library/queue/playback panels, popup frame. Own role over the text-green's Palette::Green1: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: SURFACE_RESTING
roles.uses: Resting content fill: unfocused half of library/queue/playback panels, hero pane, inline hero, sidebar body, media-list selected-row default.

roles.name: SURFACE_SIDEBAR
roles.uses: Expanded (F1-F4) sidebar body fill (chrome.rs panel shell content area; the header/footer band keeps its own ink). Own role over SCROLLBAR’s Palette::Green2: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: HERO_OVERVIEW_SEPARATOR
roles.uses: Overview/credits separator line in hero/overview painters (widgets.rs, overview_box tests).

roles.name: HERO_CREDITS_STRIPE
roles.uses: Alternating credits-row stripe background (overview_box.rs).

roles.name: HERO_CREDITS_NAME
roles.uses: Credits name-column foreground (overview_box.rs).

roles.name: ACCENT
roles.uses: Focus accent: watched indicators, folder/row icons, Emby brand glyph, queue scope-pill selected (Direct-remote aqua), visualizer low band, play icon, settings highlights, status-bar pill.

roles.name: ACCENT_ACTIVE
roles.uses: Active tab, focused pill/badge text, context-menu selected row, playlist/session selected markers, home-video secondary marker, search-sidebar marker.

roles.name: ACCENT_AUDIOBOOKSHELF
roles.uses: Audiobookshelf brand glyph (chrome_status.rs).

roles.name: PILL_ROW_BG
roles.uses: Pill-selector row background (PillRow surface; scroll-pills tests).

roles.name: PILL_BG
roles.uses: Unselected pill-chip surface (PillChip surface).

roles.name: PILL_SELECTED_BG
roles.uses: Selected pill-chip surface (PillChipSelected surface; slots.rs, search_sidebar.rs). Own role over TEXT_METADATA's Palette::Foam: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: PILL_SELECTED_FG
roles.uses: Selected pill-chip foreground text on the blue fill (slots.rs, widgets.rs, search_sidebar.rs).

roles.name: PILL_OVERFLOW_FG
roles.uses: Pill-selector overflow/edge accent (widgets.rs). Former value alias of the text green; shares TEXT_ACCENT_MUTED's Palette::Green1 today, independently editable.

roles.name: TEXT_PRIMARY
roles.uses: Primary readable content foreground.

roles.name: TEXT_SECONDARY
roles.uses: Secondary text; pairs with TEXT_PRIMARY/TEXT_STRONG; also HERO_META_ROLES[2].

roles.name: TEXT_MUTED
roles.uses: Dim text, icons, unfocused state; unselected library tab and pill-chip text; played/watched media-list row titles (chrome_tabs.rs, slots.rs, widgets.rs, queue.rs, search_sidebar.rs, media_list/row.rs).

roles.name: TEXT_STRONG
roles.uses: Bold titles/headings (warm white).

roles.name: TEXT_EMPHASIS
roles.uses: Warm emphasis text: focused rows, dialogs; also the split-row context colour's backing value.

roles.name: TEXT_FOCUS_ACCENT
roles.uses: Focused-row title accent; queue selected-scope text; paused status; home-video marker; visualizer mid band; status-bar time.

roles.name: TEXT_HERO_TITLE
roles.uses: Hero header title (first metadata line). Same value as focus accent, separate role.

roles.name: WORKSPACE_HEADER_FG
roles.uses: Workspace box header label (TRACKLIST) in a music album Hero (hero_composition.rs). Own role over MUSIC_HEADER, the music tree's artist/section role it used to borrow, and over TEXT_METADATA/PILL_SELECTED_BG's Palette::Foam: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: TEXT_ON_ACCENT
roles.uses: Near-black text painted on a coloured surface: context-menu selected row, indicator badges, hint pills.

roles.name: TEXT_ACCENT_MUTED
roles.uses: Loaded/playing/confirmed value text (library_routes.rs, multiselect.rs). Own role over SURFACE_FOCUSED's Palette::Green1: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: PLAYLIST_LOADED_FG
roles.uses: Loaded-playlist marker in the F4 playlists list (playlists.rs). Own role over PROGRESS_PERCENT’s Palette::Orange: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: PLAYLIST_STRIPE_BG
roles.uses: F4 playlists list secondary zebra fill (playlists.rs via chrome.rs row background). Own role over SURFACE_BACKDROP’s Palette::Slate: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: SETTINGS_STRIPE_BG
roles.uses: Settings/Keys list secondary zebra fill (settings_component.rs). Own role over PLAYLIST_STRIPE_BG’s Palette::Slate: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: SESSIONS_STRIPE_BG
roles.uses: F3 sessions sidebar list secondary zebra fill (three_line_flat_list.rs). Its own role replacing the sidebar-band chrome the list painted before (SURFACE_CHROME’s Palette::Ink): independently editable from that chrome and the other lists’ stripes.

roles.name: TEXT_DETAIL_META
roles.uses: Detail-screen label/meta text; HERO_META_ROLES[0].

roles.name: TEXT_METADATA
roles.uses: Secondary metadata: durations and badges; HERO_META_ROLES[1]. Also the grouped-list heading label and the hovered hero link.

roles.name: SELECTED_ROW_BG
roles.uses: Selected-row opaque bar fill; rows keep ordinary foreground roles on the bar (SELECTED_ROW_FG for the bar's own text). Shares Palette::Iris with ACCENT_ACTIVE, HERO_OVERVIEW_SEPARATOR, DURATION and the playback value roles; independently editable.

roles.name: SELECTED_ROW_FG
roles.uses: Selected-row text on the Iris bar: the media-list marker and the music tree's selected label (music_tree_label.rs, media_list/row.rs). Its own role keeps the bar's foreground independent of the title and metadata hierarchy.

roles.name: SELECTED_ROW_PROGRESS_FG
roles.uses: The resume-progress percentage on a selected row (media_list/row.rs): the bar's darker companion to SELECTED_ROW_FG, because the ordinary progress orange does not read on the light Iris bar. Shares Palette::Storm with SURFACE_RESTING and HERO_CREDITS_STRIPE; independently editable.

roles.name: STATUS_ERROR
roles.uses: Error status text.

roles.name: STATUS_AVAILABLE
roles.uses: Checkmarks, available/positive metadata (queue_playback.rs).

roles.name: DURATION
roles.uses: Right-aligned duration column of the Queue list only. Own role so a status-colour edit cannot move durations. Library browse rows carry no time.

roles.name: SPLIT_ROW_CONTEXT_FG
roles.uses: Split media-list row primary/context part (podcast an episode came from). Soft white; the playback strip keeps gold.

roles.name: SPLIT_ROW_TITLE_FG
roles.uses: Split media-list row secondary/item title. Light grey; the playback strip keeps aqua.

roles.name: INDICATOR_RESOLUTION_FG
roles.uses: Resolution glyph foreground (indicators.rs).

roles.name: INDICATOR_AUDIO_FG
roles.uses: Audio glyph foreground (indicators.rs).

roles.name: PLAYBACK_VALUE_FG
roles.uses: Now-playing title/codec value.

roles.name: PLAYBACK_META_FG
roles.uses: Playback metadata captions/time.

roles.name: PLAYBACK_TITLE_FG
roles.uses: Now-playing title row item name. Own role over ACCENT's Palette::Aqua: equal today, independently editable (now-playing-media-type-titles D2).

roles.name: PLAYBACK_CONTEXT_FG
roles.uses: Now-playing title row container (series/artist/show/subscription). Own role over the focused-row accent's Palette::Yellow: equal today, independently editable (now-playing-media-type-titles D2).

roles.name: PROGRESS_TRACK
roles.uses: Unplayed seek/progress track.

roles.name: PROGRESS_PERCENT
roles.uses: Resume-progress percentage text of a media-list row and of a hero metadata row (media_list/row.rs, hero_header.rs). Own role over the metadata blue it used to take and over INDICATOR_RESOLUTION_FG's Palette::Orange: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: GROUP_HEADING_FG
roles.uses: Group-heading rows in embedded media lists (media_list/row.rs). Own role over TEXT_METADATA's Palette::Foam: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: SCROLLBAR
roles.uses: Library/chrome scrollbar track/thumb. Former value alias of the soft content-body fill; shares its Palette::Green2 today, independently editable.

roles.name: SIDEBAR_SCROLLBAR
roles.uses: Sidebar scrollbar track/thumb (chrome.rs). Own role over TEXT_MUTED’s Palette::Grey2: the sidebar bodies paint the chrome scrollbar’s Green2, so it shares dim-text grey instead.

specials.name: Color::Black
specials.uses: Popup dim-backdrop blend base (backdrop.rs dims every cell halfway toward black). Not a palette fill.

specials.name: Color::White
specials.uses: Status-bar pills (status_bar_panel.rs), chrome_status headings. Raw ratatui named colour, not a theme role.

specials.name: Color::Reset
specials.uses: Transparent/unpainted cells: media-list gutters, marquee parts, card-painter tests. Means 'no fill', not a colour.

surfaces.name: ArtworkLoadingPlaceholder
surfaces.uses: Artwork-loading inset fill (card.rs, album_art.rs, hero painters). Own value over TEXT_MUTED's Palette::Grey2: equal today, independently editable.

surfaces.name: ArtworkPlaceholder
surfaces.uses: No-artwork surface; fixed backdrop.

surfaces.name: ContextMenuSelectedRow
surfaces.uses: Popup context-menu selected row; fixed ACCENT_ACTIVE (context_menu.rs).

surfaces.name: HeroPane
surfaces.uses: Wide hero right pane / Library Hero overlay sheet: the dark chrome the hero content repaints its own background with, fixed in both focus states (wide_hero.rs, hero overlay). Was focus-reactive content before the 2026-09-20 sheet decision.

surfaces.name: LibraryColumn
surfaces.uses: Library column gutter + wide Music browser container; follows the library panel's own focus bit — focused the level fill, resting the app backdrop (shell_library_panel.rs library_body_fill).

surfaces.name: LibraryPanel
surfaces.uses: Wide-hero rail body + frame across Movies/TV/Music/ABS/Feeds/Home (browser paint, tv_wide, music_wide, feeds, home); focused it takes the soft content-body sheet.

surfaces.name: MainContentBox
surfaces.uses: Pane content box: TV episode listing, Music track listing, generic pane inset (tv_wide, music_wide, wide_hero).

surfaces.name: PillChip
surfaces.uses: Unselected pill chip; fixed PILL_BG.

surfaces.name: PillChipSelected
surfaces.uses: Selected library pill chip; fixed PILL_SELECTED_BG blue.

surfaces.name: PillRow
surfaces.uses: Pill selector row band; fixed PILL_ROW_BG.

surfaces.name: PillRowGap
surfaces.uses: Selector-row spacer band (home.rs, library panel selector row): the panel showing through, so it follows the panel's own focus bit — the one chrome band that does.

surfaces.name: PlaybackPanel
surfaces.uses: Now-playing panel body (shell_playback projection, playback.rs default).

surfaces.name: PlaybackStatusPill
surfaces.uses: Playback status pill inset; fixed backdrop.

surfaces.name: PopupFrame
surfaces.uses: Every modal frame background (modal_frame.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: QueueCardVisualizer
surfaces.uses: Queue card visualizer slot: fills the same chrome band the queue playback panel paints, fixed in both focus states so the reserved slot never flashes a fill the panel around it does not have (card.rs).

surfaces.name: QueueColumn
surfaces.uses: Queue column gutter + queue boundary strip; follows queue-column focus.

surfaces.name: QueueOnlyPlaybackPanel
surfaces.uses: Queue-only mode playback strip (shell_draw.rs): no right column, paints chrome in both states. Mode-driven, not focus-driven.

surfaces.name: QueuePanel
surfaces.uses: Queue panel body (widgets.rs); soft focused variant, backdrop resting.

surfaces.name: QueuePanelBand
surfaces.uses: Queue panel header/status band (queue.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: QueueScopePillSelected
surfaces.uses: Queue selected scope pill; fixed ACCENT aqua = Direct-remote indicator (queue.rs), not library-pill blue.

surfaces.name: SidebarBand
surfaces.uses: Sidebar header/footer band; fixed.

surfaces.name: SidebarBody
surfaces.uses: Expanded (F1-F4) sidebar body (chrome.rs); fixed resting content value.

surfaces.name: StatusBar
surfaces.uses: Status bar band (chrome_status.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: StatusBarPill
surfaces.uses: Status bar pill inset; fixed.

surfaces.name: TabBar
surfaces.uses: Tab bar band (chrome_tabs.rs); fixed.
